_notes.key: Stable identifier for the fact. Updating an existing key replaces the value rather than appending a second record.
_notes.value: The remembered value, in whatever shape your database column expects.
_notes.category: Drives retrieval layer and retention. Suggested values: safety, preference, logistics, history.
_notes.source_session: Session the fact was extracted from. Needed for audit, correction and user-facing provenance.
_notes.write_path: Validate category against the allow-list for this deployment before writing. Reject anything not on it.
_notes.retention: Attach a retention period per category. Preferences age out; safety facts usually do not.
